name: PostgreSQL connection discipline

live_preflight.database_variable_values: Withheld by Railway OAuth. No secret was recreated or exported.
live_preflight.measurement_scope: Point-in-time production preflight and fixed service configuration, not a load-capacity measurement

connection_budget.scaling_rule: Current service remains fixed at one replica/worker. Recalculate this budget before increasing replicas/workers/pool size; the existing 20-per-process code cap is not a recommended setting.

implementation.pool: Default remains five connections. A transparent BoundedPool applies a five-second acquisition deadline to existing acquire calls, including context managers. Connect timeout 8 seconds, command timeout 20 seconds and statement_cache_size=0 retained.
implementation.tls: Existing Supabase CA/hostname verification preserved. Startup logs expose only transport class and verification flags, never the DSN or credentials.
implementation.listen: One existing shared LISTEN socket per worker retained. A regional Supavisor transaction URL on port 6543 uses the same host/credentials via session port 5432 for LISTEN; explicit/direct URLs otherwise retained. Connect/command bounds and verified TLS apply.
implementation.ordinary_external_work: Writing grading/activation/translation/pattern checks, Dictionary reads, Retention lookup, Telegram membership checks and upload storage verification release clients before waiting on external services.
implementation.telegram: Nonce-bound intent is checked again under FOR UPDATE after membership I/O; a concurrently consumed intent cannot issue a session.
implementation.imports: Storage SHA verification occurs before taking row locks. Locked claim revalidates upload ownership, state, key, MIME, size, original name and declared digest against the verified snapshot.
implementation.upload_safety: A transient prefix-read failure leaves the pending upload intact; a detected bad signature deletes only after a conditional pending-to-aborted transition. Zero-byte mismatches are rejected.
implementation.retained_atomic_dictionary_path: Owner publish/rollback/index finalization retains its existing atomic database/R2 transition for content consistency. Dictionary writers queue before borrowing a scarce client; the PostgreSQL advisory lock remains the cross-instance authority. At most one such writer per worker borrows a client, leaving the other four configured slots available. A queue timeout does not mark an unstarted durable job failed.

controlled_cases: Pool exhaustion times out and later requests recover
Cancelled waiters do not leak clients
A suspended external Writing evaluator allows another request to use a one-client pool
R2 HEAD/read and Dictionary Worker waits hold no ordinary client
Import metadata changes after storage verification fail closed
A consumed Telegram intent cannot issue a cookie after the unlocked membership check
One Dictionary writer plus queued writers leaves four ordinary slots available
Unstarted/queued publication does not mark its durable job failed
validation.fixture_adjustments: Seventeen intermediate failures were exact mock-object comparisons in two Telegram tests after a raw connection became PooledReads. Membership status, actor identity and no-session/no-account-write assertions were retained; final failures zero.

local_api_comparison.environment: Same standalone probe, disposable embedded PostgreSQL and actual ASGI; sequential local requests; thirty warmups and one hundred retained samples per scenario
local_api_comparison.gate: No observed p95 regression above ten percent; SQL counts unchanged.
local_api_comparison.limits: These samples include local scheduling/jitter and an empty Dictionary result. They do not establish a causal speedup, a production percentile or 200/500/1000-user readiness.

verify_after_release: Logged live pool size, acquisition bound, transport and verified TLS
Existing authenticated session, shared listener and normal module navigation
Recent errors and database connection count

sources: Installed asyncpg 0.32.0 public Pool.acquire signature/source inspected
